prompt: Which removes all elements from an ArrayList that are less than 5?
choices: for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) if (list.get(i) < 5) list.remove(i);
explanation: removeIf(Predicate) is the cleanest way — removes all matching elements atomically. Option B has an index bug: removing at i shifts elements left, so the next element is skipped. Option C returns a Stream but doesn't modify the original list. Option D: Collections.remove() doesn't accept a predicate.
